description: Dialog (a core TmModal) for mapping the columns of an imported file to Gantt task properties. Columns are pre-mapped by header name (case- and diacritics-insensitive; English, Czech and French names), optionally seeded by InitialMappings. Import stays disabled until Title, Start and End or Duration are mapped; two columns mapped to one field only raise a warning.

parameters.name: SourceColumns
parameters.description: Source column names from the imported file.

parameters.name: InitialMappings
parameters.description: Mappings the dialog starts from (a remembered choice, a host's own defaults). A source column is matched case-insensitively; the remaining columns are still mapped by header name, but never onto a field a host mapping already claimed.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Fires when the dialog should close.

parameters.name: OnImport
parameters.description: Fires when the user confirms the mapping.
